about: What of qa-factory/config.json a run's config_sha depends on (spec t-143 EP2-1, appendix A). Read by execution_fingerprint.projection_rules through hooklib.read_json; code holds the two selectors (row_by_profile_id, entry_by_name) and no key list. Any new execution-relevant input: add it here, rename policy_revision, update the trace.

decision_only.execution.runtime_probes: the observer's argv; its observation is hashed in runtime_sha
decision_only.environment.integrations: gate, and names in the S4 brief
decision_only.environments.frontend_url: no automated launch reads it; voids a person's confirmation via stand_definition_sha
decision_only.environments.default: the stand pick at story start; its effect is environment_id in runtime_sha
decision_only.environments.surface: the kind of stand (a row of surfaces.json): which hands and which check; the fingerprint keeps only the entry's name and address keys
decision_only.environments.driver: a device stand's Appium server address: the stand check and the hands only
decision_only.environments.device: a device stand's serial key name: the stand check and the hands only
decision_only.environments.app: a device stand's application id and activity: the stand check and the hands only
decision_only.environments.device_probe: the record of the last device check onboarding made: advisory
decision_only.implementation_repos: probe checkout; the observation is in runtime_sha
decision_only.sandbox: red probe only; red_probe is exempt from results
